phrase: This is a deterministic English speech fixture for pi watch. The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. Local transcription should preserve useful words and timestamps.

provenance.speechGenerator: macOS say, Samantha voice at 190 words per minute
provenance.mediaCommand: ffmpeg -f lavfi -i color=c=0x18324a:s=320x180:r=1:d=9.25 -i $TMPDIR/speech.aiff -map 0:v:0 -map 1:a:0 -c:v libx264 -preset veryslow -tune stillimage -crf 32 -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -b:a 48k -ac 1 -ar 16000 -t 9.25 -map_metadata -1 -movflags +faststart english-speech.mp4
provenance.regenerationNote: The committed SHA-256 is the deterministic fixture identity; byte-for-byte regeneration across tool or OS versions is not guaranteed.
